publicCopy.titleZh: Edged 在爱荷华州 Council Bluffs 两座数据中心完成主体封顶
publicCopy.titleEn: Edged completes structural topping out for two Council Bluffs data centers
publicCopy.summaryZh: Edged US 宣布，OMA01-1 与 OMA01-2 已完成主体结构封顶，推进其位于爱荷华州 Council Bluffs 的数据中心园区建设。公司称园区完工后最高可提供 200MW 容量；该数字为未来交付能力，并非已投运容量。
publicCopy.summaryEn: Edged US says OMA01-1 and OMA01-2 have completed structural topping out, advancing its data-center campus in Council Bluffs, Iowa. The company says the campus can deliver up to 200MW upon completion; this is future capacity, not capacity already in service.

publicClaims.claim: OMA01-1 and OMA01-2 completed structural topping out; the campus is stated to deliver up to 200MW upon completion.

internalNotes: The source does not disclose energization, commissioning date or capacity type.

publicCopy.titleZh: Aligned 在宾夕法尼亚州 Shippingport 为 2GW Project Phoenix 园区举行开工
publicCopy.titleEn: Aligned breaks ground on 2GW Project Phoenix campus in Shippingport, Pennsylvania
publicCopy.summaryZh: Aligned Data Centers 宣布，其位于宾夕法尼亚州 Shippingport、由三座设施组成的 Project Phoenix 数据中心园区已开工，规划容量为 2GW。公司称园区完工后将使用专属现场电源而非本地电网；2GW、供电安排及任何对电网的剩余贡献均仍属未来计划。
publicCopy.summaryEn: Aligned Data Centers announced the groundbreaking of Project Phoenix, a planned three-facility 2GW campus in Shippingport, Pennsylvania. The company says the completed campus will use dedicated onsite power rather than the local grid; the 2GW scale, power arrangement and any surplus-grid contribution remain prospective.

publicClaims.claim: Aligned announced groundbreaking for a planned three-facility 2GW Project Phoenix campus.

internalNotes: No delivery date, power-delivery timetable, customer or capacity-type definition is disclosed.

publicCopy.titleZh: 科罗拉多州 Weld County 批准 Global AI 数据中心用地许可
publicCopy.titleEn: Weld County approves land-use permit for Global AI data center
publicCopy.summaryZh: 科罗拉多州 Weld County 委员会以 5 比 0 批准 Global AI (Colorado), LLC 在 Windsor 附近既有工业设施运营数据中心的特别审查许可（USR26-0019）。该决定仅解决该项目的用地问题；建筑、电力、环保及后续扩建仍须分别取得批准。
publicCopy.summaryEn: Weld County, Colorado approved by a 5-0 vote a Use by Special Review permit (USR26-0019) for Global AI (Colorado), LLC to operate a data center in an existing industrial facility near Windsor. The decision resolves land use for this proposal only; building, power, environmental and future-expansion approvals remain separate.

publicClaims.claim: Weld County approved USR26-0019 for Global AI (Colorado), LLC by a 5-0 vote.

internalNotes: No project MW, construction timing or utility service is disclosed.

publicCopy.titleZh: ERCOT 启动 Batch Zero 大负荷互连核验 RFI
publicCopy.titleEn: ERCOT begins Batch Zero verification RFIs for interconnecting large loads
publicCopy.summaryZh: ERCOT 表示，已向多数有条件纳入 Batch Zero 的大型负荷项目发出核验信息请求。相关实体须在 RFI 发出后 10 个工作日内提交完整文件及经公证的证明材料，也可申请最多 5 个工作日的延期；未及时完整回应将被排除出 Batch Zero 互连流程。通知未披露受影响项目名单或容量总量。
publicCopy.summaryEn: ERCOT says it has begun sending verification requests for information to most conditionally included Batch Zero large-load projects. Entities must submit complete documentation and notarized attestations within 10 business days of an RFI, and may request an extension of up to five business days; a late or incomplete response results in exclusion from the Batch Zero interconnection process. The notice does not name affected projects or disclose total load.

publicClaims.claim: ERCOT began issuing Batch Zero verification RFIs; entities may request up to five business days of extension.

internalNotes: This extends existing ercot-batch-zero coverage; no individual project list or MW total is published.
